[EN] The Gauntlet Thrown Down
[ES] El guantelete ha sido lanzado
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Move quickly! Don't let Kanmur's death be in vain!
[ES] ¡Muévete rápido! ¡No dejes que la muerte de Kanmur sea en vano!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Commander Fraya at Allemantheia Headquarters and speak with her about Thulsa's movements. [Speak to {@linkcreature:72#1103#Arshadh} to enter the Allemantheia Headquarters.]
[ES] Informa a la comandante Fraya en el Cuartel General de Allemantheia y habla con ella sobre los movimientos de Thulsa. [Habla con {@linkcreature:72#1103#Arshadh} para entrar al Cuartel General de Allemantheia.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'd be honored."
[ES] "Sería un honor."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take a {@linkcreature:72#1012#pegasus} to Kaiator. Find Commander Tamur and ask for Kaiator's aid in stopping Thulsa.
[ES] Toma un {@linkcreature:72#1012#pegasus} hacia Kaiator. Busca al comandante Tamur y pide la ayuda de Kaiator para detener a Thulsa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Forgeheart
[ES] Corazón de forja
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You've arrived at the Plaza of Triumph!
[ES] ¡Has llegado a la Plaza del Triunfo!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow Commander Tamur to the Plaza of Triumph.
[ES] Sigue al comandante Tamur hasta la Plaza del Triunfo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll take care of it."
[ES] "Yo me encargo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The situation has suddenly changed. Go to Adjutant Daakem and inquire what you should do now.
[ES] La situación ha cambiado repentinamente. Ve con el ayudante Daakem y pregúntale qué debes hacer ahora.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "We will!"
[ES] "¡Lo haremos!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take Tamur's news to Ragnar.
[ES] Llévale las noticias de Tamur a Ragnar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You're welcome."
[ES] "De nada."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take Tamur's news to Garuk.
[ES] Llévale las noticias de Tamur a Garuk.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thanks.
[ES] Gracias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tell Karima that you're ready to speak to Tamur.
[ES] Dile a Karima que estás listo para hablar con Tamur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Tamur. [Speak with Karima to visit the Kaiator Headquarters.]
[ES] Informa a Tamur. [Habla con Karima para visitar el Cuartel General de Kaiator.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kaia wants to speak with you.
[ES] Kaia quiere hablar contigo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Tamur.
[ES] Habla con Tamur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Kaia.
[ES] Habla con Kaia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
